CustomField.description:
Created as part of EHIS-589, Completed when the lab result status is: F – Final/ Results are finalized and verified C – Correction/ A previously documented value is updated U – Results status change to final/ Status changed to final without resending already sent preliminary results
In Progress when the lab result status is: I – In lab / results pending P – Preliminary R – Results entered, not verified S – Partial
Cancelled when the lab result status is: D – Deleted N – Not asked O – Order detail only X – Results cannot be obtained
CustomField.label: Status Code
